The '''OT-3 Relay Droid''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when a number of OT-3 Relay Droids were stationed around the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
